meta.title: Terminal keypad
meta.description: Floats a translucent keypad over the terminal with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, a symbol key and the four arrow keys. The arrows form a plus around Esc, and Tab, the symbol key and Ctrl fill its free corners. Hold an arrow to repeat it, slide it outward for Home/End/PageUp/PageDown, slide up on the symbol key to switch it to another terminal symbol, and drag the grip to move the pad.
